# Adam's GTM Report — AEO/GEO Market Guide (agent-ready)

A continuously-refreshed map of the AEO/GEO market: a scored, sourced vendor landscape built to be loaded into an AI project and interrogated. This repo is the agent-ready mirror; the website is the source of truth: https://stack.adamgtm.com/aeo (last updated 2026-08-30).

- README.md — what this is + how to interrogate it
- report.md — the AEO map (start here)
- ai-visibility.md — who the engines actually recommend (weekly tally)
- changelog.md — what changed, dated
- sources/sources.md — every cited reference
- data/vendors.csv — scores + reasons + classification
- data/data.json — the full structured dataset (scores, agent surfaces, AI visibility)
